name: callback-coordinator
title: Callback Coordinator
description: Consent-first callback triage engine that gates a callback request against quiet hours, do-not-call, and explicit consent flags, places one CALL-E call to learn why the person needs a callback, verifies terminal result binding (call id, metadata.workflow_id, recipients phone) against intake, classifies the outcome into a fail-closed disposition (requiring status=completed and task_completed=true), and routes it to a team.
side_effects: Creates exactly one outbound CALL-E phone call per executed intake when the gate passes, the intake records consent:true, --confirm-consent is passed, and CALLE_API_KEY is set.
Performs no network access in preview mode (the default).
credentials: CALL-E API key read from the CALLE_API_KEY environment variable, used only in execute mode and sent only to https://api.heycall-e.com (trusted official HTTPS origin).
safety: Requires explicit --confirm-consent and a recorded consent:true field in the intake before any live call; missing/false consent is rejected and gates as consent_not_recorded.
Requires E.164 phone numbers with first digit 1-9 after +; +0... is rejected (pattern ^\+[1-9]\d{7,14}$).
Skips calls during quiet hours (recipient local time), for do_not_call=true, and for consent=false/missing.
Base URL is locked to https://api.heycall-e.com; arbitrary --base-url or CALLE_BASE_URL values are rejected before bearer credential use.
Uses a stable idempotency key derived from the workflow id to prevent duplicate calls.

Fail-closed disposition: verifies call identity (id), metadata.workflow_id, and recipients[].phones against approved intake (binding_* → needs_human), requires status=completed and task_completed=true, validates all structured_result enums, and routes ambiguous, unbound, low-confidence, wrong-person, unconfirmed-consent, unknown-reason, and lookup-error outcomes to a human.
Masks phone numbers in previews and removes phone-like text from evidence output, including formatted forms like (202) 555-0123, 202-555-0123, 202.555.0123, +1 (202) 555-0123, +44 20 7123 4567.
Task prompt does not offer to book a specific callback time – the result schema cannot return a time, so booking is out-of-scope.
Excludes transcripts and provider evidence that may contain personal data.
